paving.prompt: Generate ONE production game texture: a single complete square sidewalk paving slab viewed straight from above, for an orthogonal overhead grimdark cyberpunk game at native 64 by 64 pixels per slab. Full-bleed opaque square image, one slab fills the entire canvas. Muted medium warm grey / grey-olive concrete matching aged urban pavement, subdued hand-painted flat material with a few broad soft wear patches. Absolutely NO grass, moss, plants, objects, debris, markings, scratches, cracks, diagonals, inner lines, panels or grid. There is ONLY one narrow dark separation joint along the OUTERMOST edge of the canvas, about one pixel at final 64px size, straight aligned square sides, minimal restrained bevel, no second outline. Repeating this asset edge to edge must produce one slab per game cell and a single readable joint between adjacent slabs, with no internal subdivision at all. Calm broad surface areas, clear dark joints, stylized readable game art rather than photorealistic grain. Neutral flat lighting, no directional shadow or highlights, no halo, no text, no frame. The existing game will apply its accepted dirt and night lighting separately.

Designed to remain readable as a complete 12 by 10 pixel object. Generous transparent empty space on all sides. Completely clean TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Absolutely NO colored haze, NO blur, NO glow, NO soft cloud, NO shadow, NO soil, NO ground patch, NO white rim, NO other objects, NO text. Entire little tuft visible, nothing cropped.
